dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Prada is at risk due to behavior concerns. Prada has shown high kennel stress and deterioration during his time at the Care Center, including jumping and barking in his kennel, and biting at his water bowl, leading to injuries to his mouth and paws. Prada also engages in kennel fighting, which has resulted to a redirect onto a handler's leg that did not break skin. He has shown conflicted behavior when handled, approaching the handler with a loose body when coaxed and seeking proximity, but then tensing and chuffing. Medically, Prada is largely healthy but has recently been treated for wounds on his feet.

Prada was surrendered to Care by his previous owner due to housing issues. His previous family described him as a social, affectionate, playful, and very active dog. He preferred to spend most of his time wherever his family was in the home, enjoyed bath time/water, loved car rides, walks in the park, and playing with toys. He was fed a dry kibble diet of Blue Buffalo. During his stay in care, Prada has shown conflicted behaviors when interacting with handlers. He has hard work, ground, and huffed at handlers when attempting to conduct his handling assessment. After being given treats and spoken to softly, he becomes Wiggly and will approach handlers, but when attempting to engage, he immediately retreats and begins huffing again. When attempting to start his handling assessment, he begins huffing in the Assessor's face after they attempt to create distance. Due to these concerns, we recommend for product be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope Rescue partner that can allow him the time and space to decompress at his own pace..

Prada is a 1-year-old large mixed breed who has been struggling significantly in the shelter environment and is now in need of an experienced New Hope rescue partner. Before entering ACC, Prada lived with two adults, six children, and another dog, and his family described him as social, affectionate, playful, housetrained, and very active. He enjoyed walks, car rides, playing with toys, water, and simply being wherever his family was.
Unfortunately, shelter stress has brought out very different behaviors. Prada has become increasingly distressed in his kennel, including barking, kennel fighting, and biting his water bowl, resulting in injuries to his paws and mouth. He has also redirected onto a handler while being walked past other kennels, though the incident did not break skin.
Despite these concerns, Prada has shown glimpses of his social side-he can quickly become loose and wiggly when given treats and spoken to softly. He needs an adult-only rescue placement where he can decompress, feel safe, and receive patient, force-free support. Prada urgently needs out of the shelter so he can have the opportunity to return to the playful, affectionate dog his family knew.
